query:
select
            d.id,
            d.nom,
            (select count(*) from plis_recus r
             where r.destinataire_id = d.proprietaire_id and r.dossier_id = d.id)::int as "nombre!"
        from dossiers d
        where d.proprietaire_id = $1
        order by d.rang, lower(d.nom), d.cree_le
